name: ApeStaking NFT ownership accounting
summary: Pawnfi's ApeStaking credited an NFT's existing ApeCoinStaking position and caller-supplied amounts to whoever held the NFT, without receiving matching ApeCoin. Looping depositAndBorrowApeAndStake and withdrawApeCoin on borrowed BAYCs drained staked APE into sAPE collateral, against which the attacker borrowed ETH, WBTC, stablecoins and ape NFTs.

assets.symbol: NFT (1 BAYC, 6 MAYC, 2 BAKC; Blur sale proceeds in ETH)

notes: Reset: the timelocked setStakeDelegate(ApeStaking) on the P-BAYC staking token, about 4 hours after ApeStaking's deployment, granted the power to stake and withdraw APE for P-BAYC's NFTs that every withdrawApeCoin loop of the anchor needed.

Loss is gross depletion of the lending markets, ApeCoinStaking and sAPE; the inflated sAPE collateral left behind is not subtracted. The nine NFTs borrowed out have no DefiLlama price and are valued at the attacker's Blur sale proceeds (rule 12).
